narrationTexts: Confirms the bug in `orderTotal` (tax computed on pre-discount amount instead of discounted amount).
finalText:
**Suite is green.** 625 total, 625 passing.

`orderTotal` in `[src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41)` taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Changed `roundCents(cents * taxRate)` to `roundCents(discounted * taxRate)`.

That was the only bug. Nothing else to do.
